pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with smooth-edged pixel gradients. Patch size is maximal on the mid-flank and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the posterior limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways with consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcated at the intersections of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency fibrous serration visible along the dorsal neck line, creating a soft silhouette against the background.
